elements.description: The product's logo and name in an app header, as a link home or plain text.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Where the brand links to; without it (or when it isn't a safe link) the brand is plain text

properties.name: icon
properties.description: The logo – an SVG or img element, cloned before the name

properties.name: inverse
properties.description: On a dark header bar: draw the brand in the dark theme's colours whatever the page's theme

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-navigate
events.description: The linked brand was clicked ({ href }: HeaderBrandNavigate); cancelable – prevented, the link isn't followed

props.name: icon
props.description: The logo – a React node or an element, cloned before the name

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: The linked brand was clicked; call `event.preventDefault()` to route it yourself instead of following the link

changelog: **Header Brand:** `tc-header-brand` (`@adamstavely/trenchcoat/header-brand`, React `HeaderBrand`, Angular `HeaderBrand` from `@adamstavely/trenchcoat/angular/header-brand`), the product's logo and name at the start of a full-width app header. - `name`; `href` makes it a link (through `safeUrl` – an unsafe link leaves plain text); `icon`, an SVG or img element cloned before the name; `inverse` draws it in the dark theme's colours on a dark bar, as `tc-header-nav inverse` does; and `look`. - A click on the link fires a cancelable `tc-navigate` (`{ href }`): prevented, the link isn't followed, so an app's router can take it. Clicks with a modifier key are left to the browser. - Sized from the page: `--tc-hb-name-size` (default `--tc-font-size-lg`), `--tc-hb-logo-size` (24px), `--tc-hb-weight` (semibold), `--tc-hb-gap` (`--tc-space-2`) and `--tc-hb-line-height` (1.1, relative to the name's size). The name is never truncated or clipped, and the brand is centred vertically, with a focus ring on the link.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
